title: Blissful Smoke Tahini Spread
description: A creamy and nutty spread made with tahini, smoke, and bliss. Perfect as a dip or on toast.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine tahini, smoke, bliss, lemon juice, garlic, and salt.
Blend until smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the spread to a serving bowl and serve with crackers, toast, or vegetables.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
